name: Infantry_Sites
author: Infantry AI
description: Infantry AI Hosting: your hosting servers (read-only list) and SSH for agents. HOST CONTRACT ONLY: the sidecar that implements it is closed source and is not in this repository; until its binary is installed beside this file the module stays 'not loaded'.

tools.name: infantry_sites_list
tools.description: List your hosting servers (id, name, status, sshReady, ip, region, size, createdAt, destroyAt).

tools.name: infantry_sites_ssh_exec
tools.description: Run a shell command on one of your hosting servers over SSH (args: server?, command, timeoutSec?).

tools.name: infantry_sites_ssh_upload
tools.description: Write a small text file on one of your hosting servers over SSH (args: server?, path, content).

frames.description: The Sites panel: {} -> sites_list {state, message?, servers?, limit?, siteUrl?, signUpUrl?, planStatus?, reclaimableUntil?}
{server?, command, timeoutSec?} -> sites_ssh_exec {server, exitCode?, stdout, stderr, truncated?, timedOut?} (owner only)
{server?, path, content} -> sites_ssh_upload {server, exitCode?, stdout, stderr} (owner only)

config.title: Sites tab
config.applies: Applies to: the Sites tab while it is open and visible.

fields.label: Re-read the server list every (seconds, 0 = off)
